sources.paraphrase: Square one-amah incense altar, two amah high, acacia overlaid with gold, horns and crown, two carrying rings. Distinct from the outdoor sacrificial altar.
Table two by one amah, one and a half amah high; gold overlay, crown, handbreadth frame and four rings at its legs.

Table long axis follows the Sanctuary. Incense altar is central north-south, eastward of table and menorah, beyond the first third toward the curtain. Supports,28 hollow half-rods and two frankincense bowls require separate detailed modeling.
